title: Find Peak Element

story.title: Climbing to a Summit
story.text: A hiker in fog only sees the step ahead. If the ground rises to the right, a summit must be that way; otherwise one is here or to the left. Halving the trail each time finds a peak fast.
story.goal: Return the index of a peak (an element bigger than its neighbours).

hints: Any peak is accepted on LeetCode; the tests here have a single peak so the answer is unique.
